records.title: Cost question without project dimensions
turns: Is hempcrete cheaper than drywall and fiberglass?

replies:
On an initial material-by-material basis, hempcrete is actually more expensive upfront than standard drywall and fiberglass batt insulation—usually about 15 to 20% higher for the assembly. However, hempcrete replaces four different materials all at once: insulation, vapor barrier, framing infill, and interior plaster, which often balances out labor and long-term HVAC savings. Plus, you get superior thermal mass, moisture regulation, and carbon sequestration that fiberglass simply can't match.
